Name: RocRail Client
Description: OpenDeck plugin to control your model railway via Stream Deck and RocRail

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.oled.Name: OLED button
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.oled.Tooltip: OLED button for loco list, functions or speed display.

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.accessory.Name: Accessory
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.accessory.Tooltip: Control or display a track-diagram element (turnout, signal, output/button, turntable; sensors/blocks/tracks status only). Configure the item ID in the inspector.

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.dirfwd.Name: Forward
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.dirfwd.Tooltip: Set the locomotive direction to forward.

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.dirrev.Name: Reverse
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.dirrev.Tooltip: Set the locomotive direction to reverse.

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speed.Name: Speed dial
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speed.Tooltip: Dial: rotate for speed, press to stop.

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.stoploco.Name: Stop loco
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.stoploco.Tooltip: Sets the current locomotive speed to 0 km/h.

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speedplus.Name: Speed +5
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speedplus.Tooltip: Increases the current locomotive speed by five steps (% or km/h).

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speedminus.Name: Speed −5
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.speedminus.Tooltip: Decreases the current locomotive speed by five steps (% or km/h).

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scroll.Name: List scroll dial
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scroll.Tooltip: Encoder: scroll the loco list or the function list in throttle mode; same step size as the global OLED/speed dial setting.

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.back.Name: Back
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.back.Tooltip: Return to the loco list (the current loco is stopped).

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scrollup.Name: Scroll up
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scrollup.Tooltip: Scroll up in the loco or function list.

com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scrolldown.Name: Scroll down
com.marikar.rocrailcontrol.scrolldown.Tooltip: Scroll down in the loco or function list.

Localization.pi.title: Loco control
Localization.pi.hint.connection: TCP port (default 8051, same configuration as RocView).
Localization.pi.label.host: IP address of the RocRail server
Localization.pi.label.port: TCP port of the Rocrail server
Localization.pi.placeholder.accItemId: e.g. sw1, sg2, co3, fb4, bk01
Localization.pi.section.oled: OLED key settings for loco control
Localization.pi.hint.oled: Throttle views: an OLED key can show functions, loco portrait, or speed/direction.
Localization.pi.hint.http: The HTTP server in the RocRail server must be enabled.
Localization.pi.label.httpBasePath: HTTP path for loco images (default is /)
Localization.pi.label.httpIconBasePath: HTTP path for function icons (empty = same as loco images)
Localization.pi.label.accessorySvgBasePath: HTTP path for accessory SVG theme (empty = built-in symbols)
